generator.kind: synthetic-deterministic, in test code only: files written by AudioToolbox (ExtAudioFile / AudioFile) into a per-run directory under $TMPDIR, removed afterwards. No recordings, user files, network or models.
generator.seedDerivation: first 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256("ww-m2-fixture|v1|M3-DECODE-006|<split>|<index>"); SplitMix64. All 130 calibration and 520 holdout seeds are disjoint from every previous namespace and each other.

recipe.case: stratum = index mod 13. Draws in order: frames U{9000..40000}; chunkFrames log-uniform {1..65536}; then the stratum's spec (uniform over DecodeEnvelope.entries matching the stratum, then uniform sample format, rate and channel count from that entry).

strataDetail.priming-aac-m4a / priming-aac-caf / prim: lossy priming and padding per codec and container (AAC in M4A, AAC in CAF, Opus in CAF).
strataDetail.lossless-alac / lossless-flac: lossless codecs at every envelope bit depth and channel count; bit-exact.
strataDetail.pcm-integer / pcm-float: linear PCM bit depth, endianness and channel metadata (WAVE, AIFF, CAF); bit-exact.
strataDetail.origin-packet-boundary: decoded-frame origin at packet boundaries: AAC, ALAC or Opus; frames = k*P + delta with P = 1024 (AAC), 4096 (ALAC), rate/50 (Opus), k uniform over lengths in [9000, 40000], delta from {-1, 0, +1, 0, U{2..P-2}}; framesPerPacket must equal the assumed P.
strataDetail.variable-rate: any non-PCM envelope entry (variable bit rate packets) at the seeded chunk size.
strataDetail.planted-truncated: any envelope spec, file cut to fraction 0.02 + 0.95*U[0,1) of its bytes; expects DecodeFailure.isContentDamage.
strataDetail.planted-corrupt: variant = (index / 13) mod 5: damaged header (first 4 bytes XXXX), seeded random bytes (log-uniform 64..131072) or repeated text with a seeded extension, empty file, streaming-WAVE data size 0xFFFFFFFF; expects unreadableContainer, emptyFile or unsupported(unverifiableContainerLength), refused before any sink.
strataDetail.planted-unsupported: variant = (index / 13) mod 8: off-grid rate, 9-16 channel PCM, 3/4/5/7-channel ALAC, mu-law/A-law WAVE, IMA4 CAF, unsigned 8-bit WAVE, signed 8-bit AIFF, AAC in ADTS; expects the exact unsupported(reason), refused before any sink.
strataDetail.planted-stale: any envelope spec; the second metadata read reports a change (variant = (index / 13) mod 5: size grew, identifier changed, modification date changed, size unknown, vanished); expects sourceChangedDuringDecode with exactly 2 metadata reads.

truth: The generator, never the decoder's report: the written LandmarkSignal samples, the frame count, container, codec, sample format, rate, channel count and the three landmark positions per channel. Lossless and PCM cases must be bit-exact. For planted cases, the plant's expected typed error.
measurement: Each case is decoded once through the production SystemSourceContentIO gateway (counting wrapper), an adjustable metadata gateway, a security-scope ledger and a journaling sink at the seeded chunk size. Supported: every FormatInterpretation field against truth (versions, container/extension, codec, sample format, rate, channels, output format, layout), validFrames, priming/remainder (PCM 0/0; lossy priming declared; priming+valid+remainder = packets x framesPerPacket), DecodedFrameOrigin (rate, count, first frame 0, discards, duration, sourceFrame/decodedFrame/codecStreamFrame at 0, end, middle and every landmark; nil outside), DecodeReport stream-frame accounting, isVariableBitRate and packet facts, chunk sizes, decoded shape, bit-exactness, and landmark lag: the normalised cross-correlation peak of each channel's burst within +-min(3000, half the gap to that channel's nearest other landmark) of truth. A landmark below correlation 0.999 (exact) or 0.5 (lossy) counts as a landmark failure; exact formats also need lag 0. Resources released and sink finished, not abandoned. Planted: the typed error matches, nothing appended when refused before a sink, no finish, appended output abandoned, readers closed, security scopes balanced, and FileSnapshot (bytes, size, identifier, dates) equal before and after. Split level: every supported FormatInterpretation as one group through OutputSettingsPolicy (48 kHz / pcmInt24 default, current, invalidated by dropping an input, mixed rates named; .matchSources picks the most common rate, ties to the higher).
countJustification: Zero failures in n independent cases bounds the per-case failure rate below 3/n at 95% confidence (rule of three). Calibration 130 cases (10 per stratum): about 2.3% overall, 30% per stratum; enough to exercise every stratum and planted variant once before the freeze. Holdout 520 cases (40 per stratum): about 0.58% overall and 7.5% per stratum, every corrupt and stale variant 8 times and every unsupported variant 5 times; each supported case also contributes 3 x channels landmark observations (about 4900 expected). 520 cases run in a few seconds, so the holdout is cheap to run once in full.

gate.verbatim: 100% of supported truth cases mapped correctly; landmarks ≤1 output frame; every planted bad case is an explicit error with no mutation (FileSnapshot equality) and no stale publication

gates.limit: 0 supported cases with any mapping failure, changed source or unpublished result
<= 1 output frame |lag| for every landmark; 0 landmarks below the detection correlation
0 planted cases without their expected typed error
0 planted cases that published, finished a sink, left appended output unabandoned, left a reader open or unbalanced a security scope
the split's mixed-input OutputSettingsPolicy check has 0 failures
every one of the 13 strata present
